stem: Best response to variable IHC caused by inconsistent fixation:

options.text: Ignore fixation if the positive control stains

rationale: Preanalytic variables and assay controls must be standardized; retrieval cannot reliably reverse every fixation problem.

distractor_rationales.A: Increasing antibody concentration cannot correct the variable target preservation caused by inconsistent fixation.
distractor_rationales.B: Using the highest-pH retrieval for every assay is not evidence-based and can damage tissue or increase background.
distractor_rationales.C: A staining positive control does not eliminate the effect of specimen-specific preanalytic variation.

learning_objective: Select the best corrective strategy when inconsistent fixation produces variable IHC results.
